keyword: what time does the masters start
claims: The 2026 Masters weekend coverage occurs on Saturday, April 11, and Sunday, April 12.
2026 Masters weekend coverage begins at 12:00 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and the Masters App.
2026 Masters CBS television coverage is from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET.
Tee times for the 2026 Masters on Saturday and Sunday begin in the morning.
Featured groups for the 2026 Masters start around 8:55 a.m. ET.
2026 Masters weekend live streaming from 12:00 p.m. to 2:00 p.m. ET is on Paramount+ and Masters.com.
2026 Masters weekend TV coverage from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET is on CBS.
